title: Frequently Asked Questions
description: Get answers to the most common questions about Lyyli.ai's AI communication platform, security, GDPR compliance, and integrations.

faqs.question: What is Lyyli.ai?
faqs.answer: Lyyli.ai is a Finnish AI-assisted communication tool that helps you write more professional messages while maintaining your own voice. Lyyli combines your company's brand voice with your personal writing style, so every message sounds authentically like you – just better.

faqs.question: Who is Lyyli.ai for?
faqs.answer: Lyyli is perfect for small and medium-sized teams and companies, as well as professionals and leaders who value communication but have limited time. Especially professional service organizations, marketing and communications teams, and companies that want to improve their internal and external communication without losing authenticity.

faqs.question: How does Lyyli differ from other AI writing tools?
faqs.answer: Lyyli doesn't write with generic templates. It learns your company's brand voice AND each user's personal style. The result? Messages that sound like they were written by the user, not AI. Additionally, all data stays in Europe, ensuring high security and GDPR compliance without extra hassle.

faqs.question: Is my data safe?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Lyyli.ai's servers are located in Europe, and all data is processed in accordance with Finnish legislation. We use AES-256 encryption and comply with ISO 27001 standards. We also don't store your communication data on our own servers, but only use it to generate ideas.

faqs.question: What channels does Lyyli work with?
faqs.answer: Lyyli can write for many channels: emails, LinkedIn posts, Slack messages, Teams updates, newsletters, website copy. The tool recognizes channel requirements and automatically adapts the message style, structure, and length. You can also use Lyyli for other communication, such as writing speeches, podcast scripts, or video scripts.

faqs.question: How quickly can I get started?
faqs.answer: Really quickly! Setup takes just a few minutes. You enter your company's or your own website address and Lyyli creates an understanding of your tone of voice for both external and internal channels. You can edit this definition and refine the guidance, audience, and provide channel-specific examples to Lyyli. The better the examples, the better the results from the start. You'll immediately get your first communication ideas, and once you've connected your first integrations, communication ideas will start flowing at your desired pace. The more you use the service, the better Lyyli learns your style.

faqs.question: Do I need technical skills to use Lyyli?
faqs.answer: No, you don't. Lyyli is designed to be user-friendly. If you can write a message, you can use Lyyli. The interface is clear and intuitive, and no technical background is required. All integrations can be connected without IT support using simple, secure, and guided OAuth technology.

faqs.question: Can Lyyli replace a communications professional?
faqs.answer: No, and that's not the intention. Lyyli is a tool that makes communication faster and more efficient, not a substitute for expertise. It helps communicators write faster and more effectively, but strategic decisions and creative planning still remain with the user.

faqs.question: How much does Lyyli.ai cost?
faqs.answer: Our service can be subscribed on a monthly or annual license, starting at €39/month or €374/year. Pricing is per user. We also offer a free version with limited message counts and features, as well as a 30-day trial period for new users. Book a free demo and we'll go through which package suits your needs.

faqs.question: How can I try it?
faqs.answer: The easiest way is to book a free demo from our calendar. We'll show you how Lyyli works in practice and how it could improve your communication. Ready to try? Book a demo here.
